name: lookup
description: Choose one record from many by typing part of its name: the matching records are offered as you type, and the one chosen is what is sent.

use.when: a link to another record when there are too many to list, such as a person out of thousands.
use.not: a short fixed set, which is a select.
use.with: the record's name shown in the box, never its id.

name.description: Sent with the chosen record's id.

to.description: The content type the records are, such as person.

title.description: The chosen record's name, shown in the box.

hint.default: Type part of its name, then choose it from the list.

a11y.role: combobox (a text box with the matches as suggestions, from a native datalist)

keyboard.does: moves focus to and from the box
moves through the suggestions the browser shows

wcag.notes: A text box with a native datalist, so the platform draws and announces the suggestions (4.1.2). The hint says how it works (3.3.2). The name, never the id, is what a person reads and types.

machine.identify: data-to is the record type; input[type=hidden] carries the chosen id, the text box the chosen name.
machine.operate: Set the hidden input to the id of a record of type data-to, or type a name and choose it from the suggestions.
